accountContext: Signed-in publisher with five published packages. The response also contained draft and declined versions, which were omitted. The visible Published tab showed the same five package names and current version labels.
captureMethod: A read-only same-origin request ran in the signed-in Publisher Portal page through browser CDP. The parsed response was reviewed before retaining this representative fixture. Authentication material and private analytics values were not retained.
sanitization: Retained the five published package rows and omitted draft and declined rows.
Retained public package IDs, package-version IDs, names, version labels, and icon URLs so the relationship between package_versions[].id and package_key_images keys remains testable.
Omitted private or unrelated fields from package-version rows.
Changed counts and total to reflect the five retained published rows.
boundarySemantics: For the five observed packages, package_key_images is keyed by the published version row id, not package_id. Each published version had one icon entry. This does not establish behavior for multiple published versions or missing icon entries.

iconFileProbe.method: Fetched each retained package_key_images URL without credentials. Checked HTTP status and Content-Type, then decoded the image bytes with Sharp to read the format and dimensions.
iconFileProbe.results: All five retained URLs returned HTTP 200 from assetstorev1-prd-cdn.unity3d.com with Content-Type image/png. Each response decoded as a 160 × 160 PNG.
